work_summary: Bundled packages/tnf-cli into a single-file dist/cli.js (esbuild, minified, ~6.1MB, format esm, target node22) appended after tsc --build, replacing the per-file dist entry while keeping the tsc tree intact for anything importing dist subpaths.
createRequire banner shim fixes CJS deps (commander etc.) whose builtin requires fall into esbuild's dynamic-require guard; externals: bufferutil, utf-8-validate, fsevents, readline/promises.

Bundler resolves esbuild from the workspace root via createRequire so pnpm's isolated node_modules needs no new dependency; on any bundling failure it warns and keeps the tsc output, so build can never regress.

Also this session: root-caused flaky launchd services to a full disk (ENOSPC, 2Gi free); freed ~4.4GB via approved cleanup (pnpm prune/cache, old recovery capsules, recovery-tests), restarted failed services; all 20 services healthy.

verification.notes: tnf --version warm 4.1s -> 2.9-3.6s (CPU 1.3s -> 0.7s); tnf doctor ~11.9s PASS with 20/20 services; tnf models openrouter --json returns 420 live models; command-surface test PASS (512 paths); full tnf-cli test suite passes (517 checks).
